q1: SELECT b.name AS bar, COUNT(DISTINCT f.drinker) AS num_drinker, AVG(s.price) AS avg_price, (SELECT f1.drinker FROM frequents AS f1 WHERE f1.bar = b.name ORDER BY f1.times_a_week DESC, f1.drinker ASC LIMIT 1) AS most_reg_drinker FROM bar AS b LEFT JOIN frequents AS f ON b.name = f.bar LEFT JOIN serves AS s ON b.name = s.bar GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY num_drinker DESC, b.name ASC
q2: SELECT f.bar, total_num_drinker, avg_price, most_reg_drinker FROM (SELECT bar, COUNT(drinker) AS total_num_drinker FROM frequents GROUP BY bar) AS f JOIN (SELECT bar, AVG(price) AS avg_price FROM serves GROUP BY bar) AS s ON f.bar = s.bar JOIN (SELECT f.bar, f.drinker AS most_reg_drinker FROM frequents AS f JOIN (SELECT bar, MAX(times_a_week) AS mt FROM frequents GROUP BY bar) AS mf ON f.bar = mf.bar AND f.times_a_week = mf.mt WHERE f.drinker = (SELECT drinker FROM frequents WHERE bar = f.bar AND times_a_week = mf.mt ORDER BY drinker ASC LIMIT 1)) AS m ON f.bar = m.bar
